title: 罗宾·威廉姆斯子女接管其Instagram账号，抵制AI深度伪造滥用
summary: 已故演员罗宾·威廉姆斯的子女宣布接管其父亲的Instagram账号，此前其女儿泽尔达公开反对利用AI技术复原或模仿父亲形象的行为。在周二发布的一份联合声明中，扎克、泽尔达和科迪·威廉姆斯表示，他们希望将父亲的Instagram主页打造为一个“安全、可信”的空间，以对抗日益猖獗的AI深度伪造和未经授权的数字肖像滥用。此举反映了名人后代在数字时代保护逝者形象权益的新趋势，也凸显了AI技术伦理与法律监管的紧迫性。威廉姆斯家族强调，接管账号并非为了商业目的，而是为了维护父亲的遗产和尊严，防止AI技术被用于虚假内容或误导公众。该事件引发了关于AI生成内容、肖像权、以及社交媒体平台责任的热议，也促使业界重新审视AI技术在娱乐和文化遗产领域的应用边界。
summary_en: The children of the late actor Robin Williams have taken over his Instagram account after his daughter spoke out against the misuse of his AI likeness. In a joint statement on Tuesday, Zak, Zelda, and Cody Williams said they want the account to be a 'safe, trusted' space, countering the growing problem of AI deepfakes and unauthorized digital impersonation. The move highlights a new trend of celebrity families protecting their loved ones' digital legacies and underscores the urgent need for ethical and legal frameworks around AI technology. The family emphasized that the takeover is not for commercial gain but to preserve their father's legacy and dignity, sparking broader discussions about AI-generated content, portrait rights, and platform responsibility.
